                    HACKERRANK HARD • MORGAN STANLEY 2026

                

                

                    4 YRS SENIOR LEVEL

                

            


            


                Challenge: Cumulative Running Balance with Window Frames

            




            

            


                


                    🇮🇳 Marathi / MINGLISH EXPLANATION ( ):

                


                


                    🎯 Nakki Kay Sangtay:    (account_no)    (amount_inr) /      .

                


                


                    📊 Kay Output Madhe Pahije: account_no, txn_timestamp, amount_inr,  running_balance_inr  4    .

                


            




            


                Calculate each customer's running cumulative spending balance ordered by transaction timestamp, resetting on month boundary. Ensure ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW is specified to avoid duplicate peer aggregation.

            




            

            


                
📚 TOPIC CHEATSHEET & RULES:


                


                    
    

                        
  • SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY acc_no ORDER BY txn_ts) produces cumulative running totals.
    • 

                        
  • Omit frame clause defaults to RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW, which aggregates duplicate timestamps together!
    • 

                        
  • Always specify ROWS BETWEEN ... for deterministic ledger balance tracking.
    •
